info.name: Bhoomi Dhrishti – Complete API Collection
info.description: Integrated GIS-based Digital Public Infrastructure for Land Governance. SIH 2026 PS-26014 (Ministry of Rural Development, DoLR). 16 FastAPI microservices behind Nginx API gateway at http://localhost:8000. Keycloak auth at http://localhost:8080/realms/bhoomi-dhrishti. Demo users: officer@tn.gov.in/demo123, citizen@example.com/demo123, admin@bhoomi.gov.in/demo123.

item.name: 🔐 Authentication
item.description: Keycloak token endpoints for obtaining bearer tokens for officer, citizen, and admin roles. Run these first to populate the token variables.

request.description: Obtain a bearer token for the revenue officer demo user (officer@tn.gov.in). Sets the 'token' and 'officer_token' environment variables.
Obtain a bearer token for the citizen demo user (citizen@example.com). Sets the 'token' and 'citizen_token' environment variables.
Obtain a bearer token for the admin demo user (admin@bhoomi.gov.in). Sets the 'token' and 'admin_token' environment variables.
Refresh an existing access token using a refresh token. Set the 'refresh_token' environment variable before running.

item.name: 📦 Parcel Identity

item.name: 📦 Geospatial
item.description: PostGIS-powered geospatial API. Serves Mapbox Vector Tiles (MVT), GeoJSON parcel geometries, OGC WFS 2.0 / WMS 1.3.0 stubs, spatial query results, and topology conflict detection and resolution. Gateway prefix: /api/v1/geo, /api/v1/topology. Direct port: 8002.

variable.description: UUID of the parcel whose active geometry should be returned

request.description: Returns the current active geometry for a parcel as a GeoJSON Feature. Properties include area_sq_m, accuracy_class (DILRMP A/B/C/D), source_survey_date, version_number, and CRS metadata.

variable.description: UUID of the parcel to fetch open topology conflicts for

request.description: Returns all open (unresolved) topology conflicts where this parcel is either parcel_id_1 or parcel_id_2. Conflict types: OVERLAP, GAP, SLIVER, SELF_INTERSECTION.

variable.description: Map layer name: parcels, admin_districts, restriction_zones, conflicts
Tile zoom level (0 to max configured zoom)
Tile column index at the given zoom level
Tile row index followed by .mvt extension (e.g. 7258.mvt). Empty tiles return HTTP 204.

request.description: Serves a Mapbox Vector Tile (protobuf binary) for the specified layer at zoom/x/y. Tiles are generated on-the-fly by PostGIS ST_AsMVT. Content-Type: application/x-protobuf.

query.description: OGC service identifier — must be WFS
OGC request type — must be GetCapabilities

request.description: Returns a WFS 2.0.0 GetCapabilities XML document advertising Bhoomi Dhrishti feature types. Accepted by QGIS, ArcGIS Pro, OpenLayers, and other OGC-compliant clients.

query.description: OGC service identifier — must be WMS
OGC request type — must be GetCapabilities

request.description: Returns a WMS 1.3.0 GetCapabilities XML document. Advertises parcels, admin_districts, and restriction_zones layers.

Returns parcels within radius_metres of the given WGS84 coordinate, ordered by ascending distance. Uses PostGIS geography type for spheroidal distance accuracy.

item.name: 📦 Registration
item.description: Property deed registration records, encumbrances, encumbrance certificates, and ML-backed fraud detection sourced from Sub-Registrar Office (SRO) systems. Gateway prefix: /api/v1/registration. Direct port: 8004.

variable.description: UUID of the deed record to retrieve

request.description: Fetch a single deed by its UUID, including full buyer and seller party details.

variable.description: UUID of the parcel for which to generate the EC

request.description: Generate an Encumbrance Certificate (EC) for a parcel. Aggregates total deed count, active encumbrances, deeds summary, and period coverage from SRO and revenue department sources.

query.description: Parcel UUID to check for duplicate registration
Document number to check for duplicates

request.description: Detect potential double-registration of the same deed. Used during the registration workflow to prevent duplicate registrations.

query.description: Parcel UUID to run pre-checks against
Document number of the deed being registered

request.description: Return all encumbrances (both active and inactive) for a parcel, including beneficiary party details, ordered by start_date DESC.

item.name: 📦 Audit
item.description: Append-only audit trail with SHA-256 hash-chain integrity for all land governance events. Provides officer/admin event queries, tiered citizen disclosure, admin cross-entity search, and cryptographic tamper verification. Gateway prefix: /api/v1/audit. Direct port: 8011.

body.raw: {"event_type": "MUTATION_APPROVED", "actor_id": "off-tn-rev-0042", "actor_role": "REVENUE_OFFICER", "actor_org": "Taluk Office Thanjavur", "resource_type": "mutation", "resource_id": "MUT-2024-TN-00891", "parcel_id": "a1b2c3d4-e5f6-7890-abcd-ef1234567890", "purpose": "Mutation after registered sale deed", "payload": {"deed_no": "TN-REGN-2024-55123", "previous_owner": "Suresh Kumar"}, "ip_address": "10.10.1.45", "user_agent": "BhoomiDhrishti/1.0 (officer-portal)"}

request.description: Appends an immutable audit event to the hash-chained event log. Validates event_type and computes SHA-256 hash chained from the previous event. Fire-and-forget from other services.

variable.description: UUID of the land parcel whose audit trail is being queried

Number of events per page (1-200, default 50)
Filter events by type (e.g. MUTATION_APPROVED, PARCEL_VIEWED)

item.name: 📦 Notifications
item.description: Multi-channel (IN_APP, EMAIL, SMS_OTP), multi-language (en, hi, ta, te) notification delivery service. Supports 8 templates covering mutation lifecycle, parcel access, conflict detection, tax overdue, building permits, and encumbrance certificates. Gateway prefix: /api/v1/notifications. Direct port: 8012.

request.description: Send a multi-channel notification using a predefined template key. Persists IN_APP records immediately; EMAIL and SMS_OTP channels are enqueued for async delivery. Returns 202 Accepted.

variable.description: Unique identifier of the user whose notifications are being fetched

query.description: Page number for pagination (1-indexed)
Number of notifications per page (1-100, default 20)
When true, returns only unread notifications

request.description: List paginated notifications for a specific user. Returns total count, unread count, and the notification items for the current page.

variable.description: UUID of the notification to mark as read

request.description: Mark a single notification as read by setting is_read=true and recording read_at timestamp. Returns 404 if the notification ID does not exist.
List all registered notification templates with supported languages, delivery channels, criticality flag, and a sample English message.

item.name: 📦 Search
item.description: Full-text, spatial, and natural-language parcel search. Provides parcel search by free text, bounding box, land use, risk band, dispute and encumbrance filters, autocomplete suggestions, and natural language query parsing. Gateway prefix: /api/v1/search. Direct port: 8013.

request.description: Full-text and spatial parcel search supporting free text, bounding box, land use type, risk band, state/district filters, dispute status, and encumbrance status. Returns a paginated list.

query.description: Search prefix string (minimum 2 characters). Matched against ULPIN and survey number fields.
Maximum number of suggestions to return (1-30, default 10)

request.description: Returns autocomplete suggestions for parcel ULPIN or survey number based on a prefix query string.

body.raw: {"query": "agricultural parcels with high conflict risk near Coimbatore", "near_lon": 76.9558, "near_lat": 11.0168, "limit": 50}

request.description: Accepts a natural language query string, parses it into structured clauses, generates SQL, and returns matching parcels. Supports proximity-based queries when near_lon and near_lat are provided.

Gateway prefix: /api/v1/interop. Direct port: 8015.

item.name: 📦 Satellite
item.description: Satellite watch service using NDVI/NDBI land-use change detection with Sentinel-2 and Cartosat imagery. Detects agricultural to non-agricultural conversion, encroachment on water bodies and forest land, and large layout development at 10m resolution. Gateway prefix: /satellite. Direct port: 8016.

variable.description: LGD village code identifying the village to analyse

request.description: Get land-use change detection results for a village using Sentinel-2 imagery at 10m resolution. Detects AGRI_TO_NON_AGRI, encroachment on water bodies, and large layout developments. Requires revenue_officer or admin role.

variable.description: LGD village code identifying the village to retrieve change layers for

request.description: Get change detection results as a GeoJSON FeatureCollection layer for mapping. Returns polygons of detected changes with properties for visualization.

variable.description: LGD village code identifying the village to query affected parcels for

query.description: Filter results by change type: AGRI_TO_NON_AGRI, ENCROACHMENT_WATER, VEG_TO_BARREN, WATER_BODY_FILL
Minimum change area in square metres (default 100.0)

request.description: Get list of parcels affected by detected land-use changes for a village. Useful for generating notices or investigation lists. Results ordered by change area descending (up to 200 parcels).
Get information about Sentinel-2 satellite imagery resolution and limitations. Describes what land-use change types can and cannot be detected at 10m resolution.

item.name: 📦 Workflows
item.description: Workflow Orchestrator Service for end-to-end cross-departmental land governance processes. Includes property sale with pre-registration checks, building permission with automated compliance screening, and unauthorized land-use conversion detection with field enforcement assignment. Gateway prefix: /workflows.

request.description: Execute end-to-end property sale workflow: (1) Parallel pre-checks for encumbrances, disputes, ownership, area consistency, zoning; (2) Register sale deed with SRO; (3) Trigger mutation to Revenue; (4) Notify ULB for tax assessment; (5) Log audit trail.

Execute building permission workflow: (1) Auto-screen for zoning compliance, FSI/FAR limits, setback requirements, tax dues, encumbrances; (2) Route to planning officer; (3) Notify applicant with result.

Execute unauthorized land-use conversion detection workflow synchronously: (1) Satellite change detection; (2) Cross-reference approved permits; (3) Flag unauthorized conversions; (4) Create enforcement cases; (5) Assign to field officers. May be long-running for large regions.
Schedule unauthorized land-use conversion detection to run as a background task. Returns immediately with a scheduled status while detection runs asynchronously. Use for large-scale regional scans.

item.name: 📦 Revenue Records (RoR)
item.description: Manages Records of Rights (RoR), land rights, mutations, and parties for the Bhoomi Dhrishti land governance platform. Handles ownership history, tenancy/share-crop rights, mutation lifecycle (create/approve/reject), and party (landholder) search and lookup.

request.description: Basic liveness probe — always returns 200 if the process is up. No database check.
Readiness probe — checks database connectivity by executing SELECT 1. Returns 503 if the database is unreachable.
Returns the most recent Record of Rights (RoR) for a parcel, including all associated rights with party details and provenance metadata. Emits a READ_ROR audit event.

variable.description: UUID of the land parcel

request.description: Returns all rights entries (ownership, tenancy, sharecrop, etc.) for a parcel with party details, ordered by valid_from descending. Emits a READ_RIGHTS audit event.

variable.description: UUID of the land parcel

request.description: Returns all mutation records for a parcel ordered by submitted_at descending. Emits a READ_MUTATIONS audit event.

variable.description: UUID of the land parcel

request.description: Returns the full temporal ownership history for a parcel — all historical rights and ownership changes ordered by valid_from descending. Includes party details, share fractions, validity periods, and source attribution. Emits a READ_ROR_HISTORY audit event.

variable.description: UUID of the land parcel

item.name: 📦 Planning & Zoning
item.description: Manages master plan zoning regulations, building permissions, and court dispute linkages for parcels. Schemas for ZoneResponse, BuildingPermissionResponse, and DisputeResponse are defined in schemas/planning.py but no domain routers are wired into main.py yet — only the health/readiness probes are active.

request.description: Kubernetes liveness probe. Returns service name and current UTC timestamp to confirm the process is alive.
Kubernetes readiness probe. Checks database connectivity via check_db_health() and reports uptime. Returns HTTP 200 when ready, HTTP 503 when the database is unhealthy.

item.name: 📦 Trust Engine
item.description: Cross-registry conflict detection, ML-based anomaly scoring (Isolation Forest), and transaction network graph analysis for land parcels. Surfaces suspicious patterns such as area/ownership inconsistencies, circular trading chains, and rapid parcel flipping for officer review.

request.description: Returns service liveness status and current UTC timestamp. Used by Kubernetes liveness probe.
Checks database connectivity and returns readiness status. Returns 503 if the database is unhealthy. Used by Kubernetes readiness probe.

Returns a ranked list of parcels with ML anomaly scores above the given threshold, ordered by score descending. Revenue officers are automatically scoped to their assigned district. Uses Isolation Forest model results stored in ml.conflict_scores.

query.description: Filter results to a specific state LGD code
Filter results to a specific district LGD code; overridden by actor's district if role is revenue_officer
Minimum anomaly score threshold (0.0–1.0, default 0.5)
Maximum number of results to return (1–1000, default 100)

request.description: Returns the latest Isolation Forest anomaly score for a specific parcel. Returns 404 if no anomaly score has been computed for the parcel.

variable.description: UUID of the parcel in the identity.parcels table

request.description: Triggers a full re-run of the Isolation Forest anomaly detection model for the specified state/district scope, persisting results to ml.conflict_scores. Officers are restricted to rescoring their own district. Returns 202 Accepted on success.
Returns aggregate counts and score statistics for anomalies broken down by risk band (HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW). Revenue officers are automatically scoped to their district.

query.description: Filter aggregation to a specific state
Filter aggregation to a specific district

request.description: Detects circular trading patterns in the land transaction graph (e.g. Party A → B → C → A). Returns chains with party/parcel involvement, time window, and confidence score. Indicates potential shell company networks or circular trading.

query.description: Filter transaction graph to a specific state
Minimum number of parties in the chain (3–10, default 3)
Maximum number of chains to return (1–200, default 50)

request.description: Identifies parcels that have been transferred multiple times within a short window. May indicate speculative trading or value manipulation. Uses a sliding window query over revenue.mutations.

Maximum number of results to return (1–200, default 50)

request.description: Computes a network-topology-based risk score for a specific party using degree centrality, betweenness centrality, involvement in circular chains, and rapid flip count. Returns 404 if the party has no transactions in the graph.

variable.description: UUID of the party in revenue.parties

request.description: Returns an N-hop ego network centered on a parcel or party, formatted as nodes and edges for D3 visualization. Either parcel_id or party_id must be provided. For a parcel, all parties involved in its mutations form the center.

UUID of the party to center the ego network on

request.description: Runs a complete graph analysis including circular chain detection, rapid flip detection, and top-20 high-risk party scoring. A heavy operation that builds the full transaction graph. Restricted to non-citizen roles only.

item.name: 📦 Citizen Services
item.description: Tiered parcel profiles with disclosure controls, citizen service applications (mutation, encumbrance certificate, building permit, dispute filing, land use change, boundary correction), and application tracking for the Bhoomi Dhrishti land governance platform.

request.description: Returns service liveness status. No database call — used by load balancers and container orchestration probes.
Verifies the service can reach its PostgreSQL database by executing a lightweight SELECT 1 probe. Returns 503 if the database is unavailable.

Returns a parcel profile whose depth is governed by the caller's role encoded in the Authorization header. PUBLIC (no auth): geometry, ULPIN, encumbered/dispute booleans only. CITIZEN (own parcel or CONSENT_GATED): adds rights, encumbrances, disputes, and own deeds. OFFICER/ADMIN roles: full detail including all parties unmasked, conflict scores, deed history, and pending mutation count. Fires a fire-and-forget audit event to the audit service on every call.

variable.description: Internal UUID of the parcel (identity.parcels.id)

request.description: Returns all active parcels for which the authenticated citizen holds a right (ownership, co-ownership, etc.). The citizen is identified by the subject embedded in the Authorization header (matched against aadhaar_hash, mobile_hash, or voter_id_hash). Returns 401 if no valid subject is present.

Creates a new citizen service application for a specified parcel. Supported types: MUTATION_REQUEST, ENCUMBRANCE_CERTIFICATE, LAND_USE_CHANGE_PERMISSION, BUILDING_PERMIT, PARCEL_BOUNDARY_CORRECTION, DISPUTE_FILING. Validates parcel existence, assigns a human-readable reference number (e.g. MUT-2026-A3F0B1), and persists to citizen.applications. Returns the created application with SUBMITTED status.
Retrieves a single service application record by its UUID, including current status, reference number, submitted details, and any officer remarks. Returns 404 if the application does not exist.

variable.description: UUID primary key of the application in citizen.applications

request.description: Returns a paginated list of all service applications submitted by a given citizen, ordered by submission date descending. The citizen is identified by the required applicant_id query parameter. Supports pagination via page and page_size.

query.description: Keycloak subject or citizen ID used when the application was submitted
Page number, 1-indexed. Defaults to 1.
Number of applications per page. Min 1, max 100. Defaults to 20.

request.description: Returns the full list of available citizen services with metadata: type code, human-readable name, description, required documents list, SLA in days, and fee in INR. Used by the citizen portal to display the services menu.

item.name: 📦 Analytics & NL Query
item.description: Dashboard aggregations, KPIs, conflict taxonomy, resolution metrics, onboarding tiers, land-use trends, service delivery metrics, and natural language SQL query interface for the Bhoomi Dhrishti land governance platform.

request.description: Returns service liveness status. No database call.
Returns service readiness by executing a test query against the database. Returns 503 if the database is unavailable.

Returns a comprehensive dashboard for a district: total and ULPIN-covered parcels, conflict counts by risk band, pending mutations, average mutation processing time, data completeness percentage, last revenue and registration sync timestamps, top conflict types, and recent land-use change count (last 90 days).

variable.description: LGD (Local Government Directory) code for the district

request.description: Returns an aggregated state-level dashboard: total parcels, ULPIN coverage, number of districts with data, high-risk parcel count, onboarding tier (BRONZE/SILVER/GOLD based on ULPIN coverage), data completeness, and top conflict types across all districts in the state.

variable.description: Two-letter state code (e.g. TN for Tamil Nadu)

request.description: Returns aggregated conflict scores grouped by score type and risk band, with count and average score value. Optionally filtered to a specific state.

query.description: Filter conflict summary to a specific state code

request.description: Returns entity-resolution (ER) precision, recall, and F1 scores computed from parcel match candidate outcomes (CONFIRMED, FALSE_POSITIVE, FALSE_NEGATIVE). Also returns raw counts and the timestamp of the computation.

Returns the onboarding tier status (BRONZE/SILVER/GOLD) for every state that has parcel data, along with ULPIN coverage percentage, last sync timestamp, and lists of met and missing onboarding requirements.
Returns monthly land-use change trends grouped by change type, with count and average confidence score per month. Supports rolling window of 1–36 months and optional state filter.

query.description: Filter trends to a specific state code
Number of past months to include (1–36, default 12)

request.description: Returns per-application-type service delivery statistics: total applications, completed count, average processing days, 90th-percentile days, and SLA-met percentage. SLA thresholds are defined per application type (e.g. mutation 30 days, EC 3 days). Optionally filtered to a state.

query.description: Filter service delivery metrics to a specific state

request.description: Converts a plain-English question about parcels, owners, or land records into SQL via template/regex matching (no LLM API required) and executes it. Results are automatically filtered by the authenticated actor's role and jurisdiction (state/district). Requires authentication; access is tiered by role.

body.raw: {"text": "Find parcels with area mismatch greater than 20%"}

request.description: Returns a list of pre-defined example natural language queries that the template engine recognises. Use these as templates to construct supported queries.

Returns metadata about the natural language query engine: approach (template-based, no LLM), supported pattern categories, role-based tiered access rules, known limitations, and performance characteristics.

Returns user-facing help text with tips for writing effective natural language queries, common keywords by category (spatial, administrative, ownership, intelligence), and role-specific example queries.
